}}Uses a [[Whetstone]] to repair axes, pickaxes and shovels. There are currently only two grindstones on the map, located at [[Workyard|the Workyard]] and the Blacksmith's house (located in [[The Village]]). It cannot be built.

In the UI for the grindstone, you are given the option to place a single tool, and then a whetstone.
